glovebox.note: 1200 x 1120 x 790 mm interior, sloped long windows (57 and 60 mm lean)

antechamber door.note: hub and rim back-projected onto the wall plane from Overhead 2: radius 180-190 mm, matching the 15-inch antechamber (datasheet 190 mm)

QR sign.note: bottom edge back-projected onto the wall from Overhead 2; the top is out of view

ducts.note: 40 x 60 mm slotted duct (a common Panduit size), along the edges seen in both views

breadboards.note: edges back-projected onto their planes; holes M6 on 25 mm (the hole rows measure 24.5-26.4 mm at these heights); sizes rounded to Thorlabs metric sizes where the edges are hidden

chip tray.note: 6 x 10 pockets fitted in both views; pitch 9.5 mm, centre and yaw from the joint calibration; chips placed per pocket from chip_tray.json (3 empty, 1 rotated)

gantry.note: posts (147 mm), plate edge, both screw axes and the Y motor back-projected from Overhead 2 at their heights; NEMA 23 (56.4 mm) and NEMA 17 (42.3 mm) flanges; SFU1605 screws

exfoliator.note: reel centres triangulated; housing, motors and stage back-projected from Overhead 1; reel diameter 85-95 mm from the image size at the triangulated distance

microscope.note: objective on the Overhead 1 ray at the chamber model's height (z 250); elevated breadboard back-projected at z 380; Thorlabs box front edge at z 180-220

tape measure.note: back-projected onto the deck from Overhead 2; case size of a 25 ft tape
